units.source: FFF 后端架构方案确认

units.target: Following the decision of General Manager Ri on April 10th: FFF backend and database will be independent, not sharing accounts with Arrowfish. This week's task is to evaluate the reuse scope — public logic such as payment, quota management, and VPN node management can be shared modules for reusability, avoiding code duplication.
